latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Subtitle Downloader.

- Extracts and downloads subtitles from video files up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM supported).
- Connects to cloud GPU backend for rapid processing (20–40 seconds per video).
- Provides 1080p MP4 downloads, subtitle export, and translation support for content creators.
- Handles authentication automatically with user token or free anonymous access.
- Supports uploading, session management, credit checks, and multiple export formats.
- Clear error reporting and guided user interaction throughout the workflow.
